outcome: time from anesthesia to surgical incision
Apgar scores of the neonates recorded at 1 minute and 5 minutes
visual analog scale (VAS) pain scores on postoperative Day 1
cohort: 334 parturients who received epidural labor analgesia but needed subsequent CS under regional anesthesia
finding: For parturients with labor epidural analgesia needing CS, the use of SA led to shorter anesthetic time and lower postoperative pain scores, with lower morphine doses compared with EA.
